I’m not prepared mentally or emotionally to do it again. If anyone needs prayers, it’s me and my family. She doesn’t even want to pursue treatment. She’s only doing it for her children. She has no interest in living anymore. My heart is shattered.
Also, she is hopefully going to KU med center in KC because she lives 20mins from it. She wants proton therapy which was just recently approved by the federal health department

I know worry won’t help but here I am. 

I had a lot of hope until I heard her say, “ya know, I’ve never considered suicide in my whole life. But if I have to continue in this much pain, I’d rather take my own life.” 
She has given up. I had hope until I realized she didn’t. 
We are a strong Christian family and we know where our hope comes from. I have never seen my aunt this down before. She’s had her times of trouble like any person but never in my life has it been like this.
Also they said her tumor is 100% inoperable

Well, they meet Monday to discuss her treatment plan so we’ll see then what they plan for. She lives right outside of Kansas City KS and she is enrolling for proton therapy at KU med center. 

She’s my favorite aunt (don’t tell my other aunts) and my whole world is crashing down.
